name: Can insulation help with soundproofing my home?

mainEntity.name: Can insulation help with soundproofing my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, certain types of insulation can significantly help with soundproofing. Denser materials like blown-in cellulose or mineral wool are particularly effective at absorbing sound waves and reducing noise transmission between rooms or from outside. Even standard fiberglass batts offer some level of sound attenuation. While primary insulation aims for thermal performance, choosing the right material can provide the added benefit of a quieter indoor environment, enhancing your home's comfort.
